referenceFunction.generalComment: The average net efficiency is 80 %. The stoker boiler is assumed to fire egg coal with quality between long-flame coal and fat coal. The heating value (28.9 MJ/kg) and the composition of the coal are average values available from the literature. The emission data are also taken from literature reporting measurements performed at the end of the 1980s in Germany. Size distribution of particles has been estimated on the basis of recent information from EPA. Emissions of trace elements were calculated using the ash content in the coal and average transfer coefficients for coal power plants with ash retention of 98 %, as first approximation. With the assumption that coal is stored in a dry storage, no leaching is considered. Possible emissions to water during operation of the boiler are not included for missing information.; UUID: 78fa456f-a455-38b2-9332-67df26933a8c
